### Contributing guidelines

- [X] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

### Module(s)

mini.bufremove, mini.pick

### Question

My goal is to change how neovim handles opening a directory to the following:

1. `nvim /home/me/config-dir/`
2. Open `MiniPick.builtin.files(), user chooses a file and opens it
3. Delete the current buffer (by default, neovim created this buffer with the name of the directory, `config-dir` in the this example)

---

My autocmd is working, except the filetype of the file picked in `MiniPick` isn't detected, so there's no treesitter syntax, no LSP, it's a no-ft buffer until I manually `:edit` or `:bufdo edit`

What am I missing?

```lua
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('VimEnter', {
	desc = 'Handle opening with `nvim <dir>`',
	callback = function(data)
		local is_dir = vim.fn.isdirectory(data.file) == 1
		if is_dir then
			vim.cmd.cd(data.file) -- chande nvim's pwd to `/home/me/config-dir` (see above)

			local current_buffer = vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf() -- the empty buffer named `config-dir`
			MiniPick.builtin.files() -- pick another file to open
			-- ISSUE: THE FILE IS OPENED WITH NO filetype

			-- Alternative to below: vim.api.nvim_buf_delete(current_buffer, { force = true })
			MiniBufremove.delete(current_buffer, true) -- delete the empty buffer

			vim.cmd.edit '%' -- THIS DOESN'T HAVE ANY EFFECT ON THE NEWLY OPENED BUFFER
		end
	end,
})
```

comment_data.body:
> What am I missing?

[A `nested = true`](https://neovim.io/doc/user/autocmd/#autocmd-nested) flag for an autocommand. Filetype detection requires triggering `FileType` event, which is not done if the file opened inside (some) autocommand callbacks that don't have `nested` flag.
comment_data.bodyHTML:
What am I missing?

A nested = true flag for an autocommand. Filetype detection requires triggering FileType event, which is not done if the file opened inside (some) autocommand callbacks that don't have nested flag.
